first.rationale: Prioritize onboarding simplification because the concurrent declines in onboarding completion and activation indicate a shared funnel failure, and inherited evidence supports durable self-serve adoption gains. Verify the onboarding result and the competing pricing result because pricing is highly consequential under the competitor threat but may trade sustainable value for short-term acquisition. Run a standard controlled experiment rather than assume the historical effect transfers unchanged.

final.rationale: Run a standard controlled onboarding-simplification experiment. The verified prior result directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and showed higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%), supporting sustainable downstream value. Promotional pricing is not selected: its verified qualified-revenue lift was coupled with a 12% retention decline and failure to survive renewal. Track qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation because historical onboarding evidence does not by itself establish the full long-term revenue effect in the current market context.
